audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN 6/10 with Skill at Levels 1, 4-5 and 6, against a 46.07% win rate and prose that says 'Levels 4-5 stay his' and 'At 6 the lane flips'.
audit.corrected: HARD 7/10 and the chart realigned in both layers.

audit.why: Gwen's only spike is Level 6 into Riftmaker plus Executioner's; Tryndamere's is continuous, with Undying Rage at 80-120s as the late reason not to commit.
audit.corrected: Each phase why names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two interactions that actually decide the lane were absent from both layers.
audit.why: Riot on Mocking Shout: 'decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.' The slow is conditional on facing away, so turning and strafing removes it entirely — and the AD reduction costs an AP Gwen nothing. Riot on Spinning Slash: 'Tryndamere slices toward a target unit' — it needs a unit, so from outside Hallowed Mist, which only enemies inside it can target, he cannot spin onto her at all.
audit.corrected: Both written into the phase whys, cooldown block, trading rules, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Undying Rage was tracked, and with no number.
audit.why: Mocking Shout is a flat 14s, Spinning Slash 12/11/10/9/8s, Bloodlust a flat 12s, Undying Rage 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Mocking Shout and Spinning Slash are now the lane cooldowns; Undying Rage stays the late-game gate.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Tryndamere contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Battle Fury crit autos plus Bloodlust healing beat your cone at 1. Mocking Shout only slows enemies with their backs turned — so face him.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Tryndamere's Undying Rage is down.
edits.after: Spinning Slash needs a target unit at 650 range. Deny him minions to spin off and he cannot reach you.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Tryndamere must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash arrives, but Bloodlust is a 12s heal off Fury — chip that he refunds. Do not open a war you cannot finish.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Undying Rage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: W-slow into Spinning Slash pins you at 650 with no Mist to answer. Never turn your back — the slow only lands from behind.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tryndamere's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your one flip: Spinning Slash targets a unit, so from outside Hallowed Mist he cannot spin onto you at all. Slow him and grind.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Undying Rage's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker plus Executioner's — Bloodlust is what your snips must out-pace, not his crits.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Tryndamere carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 5 seconds of unkillable at 80-120s. Never open a burst into it — wait it out, then Needlework the retreat.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then R-slow. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tryndamere Mocking Shout (14s): the slow lands only on enemies with their backs turned — face him and walk sideways. - Spinning Slash (8-12s): needs a target unit. - Undying Rage (80-120s): 5s unkillable. - Needlework: kill windows.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Tryndamere with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Tryndamere wastes Undying Rage — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Tryndamere with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Spinning Slash is spent and no minion is near — he cannot reach you for 8-12s, so commit. Bad trade: running away from a Mocking Shout, which is the only way its slow applies to you at all.

edits.before: Track Tryndamere's Undying Rage: Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then R-slow. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.

edits.before: Pre-6 with no untargetability, his W-slow into E-engage pins you and his spin grinds you down.
edits.after: Mocking Shout slows only enemies with backs turned — face him, and his engage loses its setup.

edits.before: Use W slow into E gap-close to pin you outside Hallowed Mist range and force the all-in on his terms
edits.after: Catch you fleeing so Mocking Shout's back-turned slow lands, then Spinning Slash outside Mist range

notes: Mocking Shout's slow is conditional on the target's back being turned, and its AD reduction is dead weight against an AP Gwen — neither was on the page, and the existing advice (give ground, back off) is exactly what makes the slow land. Spinning Slash requiring a target unit is also why Hallowed Mist shuts his gap-close off completely rather than merely dodging it.
